company.description:
REZI is a rental company that provides leasing and financial technology for tenants, property owners, and landlords. The company uses its proprietary analytics, technology, and financial products to improve the rental experience for landlords and tenants alike. It operates with the goal of automating the rental process, decreasing discriminatory practices in renting, and improving outcomes for property owners.

REZI was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in New York.
